change: Emigration Ordinance promulgated, with the Emigration Rules.
Emigration Act adopted, creating the Protector General of Emigrants and the clearance system.
Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment Act adopted.
Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act (RA 8042) adopted after the execution of Flor Contemplacion in Singapore.
Ratifies the UN migrant workers convention.
Employment Permit System memoranda with South Korea signed by Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Sri Lanka.
Clearance withheld from women under 30 with ECR passports for work in ECR countries.
Foreign Employment Act adopted, with a welfare fund, labor attachés and a tribunal.
RA 10022 strengthens RA 8042: compulsory insurance, certification of destination countries.
Ratifies the UN migrant workers convention.
Ratifies the UN migrant workers convention (Law No. 6 of 2012).
Ratifies ILO C189 on domestic workers, the second state to do so.
Overseas Employment and Migrants Act adopted.
Placement of domestic workers with individual employers in 19 Middle Eastern countries halted.
'Free visa, free ticket' policy for Malaysia and six Gulf states.
OWWA Act (RA 10801) puts the welfare fund on a statutory footing.
Law No. 18 of 2017 replaces the 2004 placement law, shifting the emphasis to protection.
ASEAN Consensus on migrant workers adopted in Manila.
Agreement with Kuwait on domestic workers after a deployment ban.
Wage Earners' Welfare Board Act adopted.
BP2MI Regulation 9/2020 exempts ten occupations from placement costs (implementation later postponed).
Law 69/2020 on workers abroad adopted (in force January 2022); workers no longer refund brokerage commissions.
Department of Migrant Workers Act (RA 11641) creates a dedicated department.
MOU with Malaysia on domestic workers (one-channel system).
Cabinet approves removal of the Family Background Report for women migrant workers.
MOU with Taiwan on labor mobility.
Ratifies ILO C190 on violence and harassment in the world of work.
BP2MI becomes the Ministry for the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers (KP2MI).
Minimum age for women going abroad as domestic workers lowered from 35 to 25.

Ratifies ILO C190 on violence and harassment in the world of work (in force for Sri Lanka from April 2027).
Circular 09/2026 amends the implementing rules on fees and procedures.
